memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then at the Lord's command Moses gave this order to the Israelites: "What the tribe of the descendants of Joseph is saying is right. This is what the Lord commands for Zelophehad's daughters: They may marry anyone they please as long as they marry within their father's tribal clan. No inheritance in Israel is to pass from one tribe to another, for every Israelite shall keep the tribal inheritance of their ancestors." - Num 36:5-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gives a solution that honours everyone. He affirms that the clan's concern is right, and He provides a way forward: the daughters may marry whomever they wish, as long as it is within their own tribe. This protected both the daughters' inheritance and the tribe's allotment. No one lost out. The daughters kept their land and their freedom to choose a husband; the tribe kept its inheritance intact. God's wisdom found a path that cared for all parties.

This is so characteristic of God. When we bring our concerns to Him, He does not offer clumsy solutions that help one side while harming another. His wisdom is able to hold competing needs together and find a way that honours all. He is a God of perfect wisdom, and His answers are good.

Notice too that God took the concern seriously and responded to it. He did not dismiss the clan's worry as unimportant. The God of the universe attended to a question about tribal land inheritance and gave a careful, wise answer. Nothing is too small for His attention.

We can bring our tangled situations to God with confidence, knowing that His wisdom far exceeds ours. When we face dilemmas that seem to have no good answer, when competing needs pull against each other, we can trust the God whose wisdom is limitless. James tells us that if we lack wisdom, we should ask God, who gives generously (Jas 1:5). And in Christ, we find the very wisdom of God made ours (1 Cor 1:30). Bring your hard situations to Him; He is able to make a way.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you trust God's wisdom when facing situations with no easy answer?
2. How have you seen God provide a wise way through a difficult dilemma?
3. What tangled situation do you need to bring to God for His wisdom?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: All-wise God, thank You that Your wisdom finds good paths where I see none. Help me to bring my hardest dilemmas to You, trusting that You care about every detail and can make a way. Amen.
